name: qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_s7
slot_change_request: KVCTRL core_s7 child of the c1 wires-parent qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static (247.512 x 378 controller slot). Sched: W = controller command / strap / drain face, E = port + ECC seams, S = PHY po, N = cdc / obs seams + clock.

job.purpose: KVCTRL core_s7 (lead Q-KV decision 2026-10-17): core_s6w CLOSED TT +4.34 / FF +10.33 but native audit FAIL (R 265.4: one hclk root of 13.8k sinks over 116.6 x 216 um measured ~275 ps TT insertion; launch 420.6 on 216 pins, capture 401.5 on 175 pins incl. ~155 ps of hold-ECO IO padding). The core is split into three hardened children with short roots (target R <= 170), every pin flop-first: qkd_ctrl_pc_sched (u_ctl, tag queue, raw check, arbiter, W/E pin flops, KV drain / idle_hbm), qkd_ctrl_pc_cdc_child (u_ecdc both clocks + core-clock intake / intake check / er / core drain / idle_core / static completion crossing, with pin registers on the u_ctl credit and the embedding return and output registers on the down FIFO), qkd_ctrl_pc_obs_child (native write observer behind input pin registers + native commit pin registers). Priced vs core_s6: static embed command +1 hclk, embedding return +1 hclk, u_ctl credit +1 hclk, native commit observation +1 hclk; KV read/write traffic 0 edges. Sched: W = controller command / strap / drain face, E = port + ECC seams, S = PHY po, N = cdc / obs seams + clock.
